Questions partners ask

Do I keep my own name and clients?

Yes. You stay an independent practice. Your clients, your brand and your data stay yours, and our partner agreement includes a mutual non-solicit clause.

Do I have to use Virta?

Yes. Virta is the heart of the partnership: it’s where the saving and the support come from. We convert your clients’ books for free to get you started.

How is pricing worked out?

By the companies and individuals you look after, each with its own band. The more companies you have, the lower the rate per company. Bands are reviewed once a year.

What if I want to leave?

After the first 12 months you can leave on a month’s notice. You can stay on Virta at the standard price; the partner pricing, badge and directory listing stop.

Tell us about your practice. We’ll call you, then send a savings quote showing what you and your clients pay today against your partner pricing. No obligation.

What your practice pays for software each month

Only what your practice pays and keeps as its own cost. We use it to work out your saving; your partner pricing comes from your client numbers.

Clients who pay for their own accounting software

Including subscriptions you pass on to clients. These clients could cancel theirs once their books are on Virta.

After our first call we’ll ask for proof of these amounts: a billing-page screenshot or last month’s invoice for each tool. We use it only to prepare your savings quote and delete it once the quote is done.
